answer: A payout is split so that 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The summit schedule is applied in tide and juniper makes public each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2304 identities would post 3543 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
